messages.text: Well, one of the basic things about any writing is to remember 3 key points. Number One, say what you're going to say. messages.text: When can I go to see him?
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 1
messages.text: Anytime except today. Please give him a call before you come.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 2
messages.text: OK.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 1
messages.text: Will you give your friends a buzz and put out a feeler to see if they like to offer me a loan?
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 2
messages.text: Give them a buzz? What can I say to them? Say that you want a loan?
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 1
messages.text: I just want to make sure that there is possibility of giving us a loan.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 2
messages.text: And they, too, want to make sure their loan is worthwhile.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 1
messages.text: Don't turn the dishwasher on! The baby just fell asleep. I need a break! I'm exhausted from cooking soup and baking cookies all morning.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 2
messages.text: Oh! I'll run it later, then. Let's sit outside and read while she sleeps.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 1
messages.text: Old Dyson looks as if he maybe kick the bucket any day.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 2
messages.text: Why do you say that?
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 1
messages.text: I've ever seen a living being looked so thin.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 2
messages.text: Really? In my eyes it's normal, as an old man, to be thin is better than to be fat.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 1
messages.text: Maybe you are right.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 1
messages.text: who are you writing a letter to?
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 2
messages.text: I'm just responding to Sue's letter. Do you want to help?
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 1
messages.text: OK. I guess I could add something. Tell them that I send my love.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 2
messages.text: that's kind of boring. Don't you want to tell them anything else?
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 1
messages.text: well, maybe you could tell them about my promotion.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 2
messages.text: you've been promoted? when did that happen?
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 1
messages.text: just today. I guess I forgot to mention it.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 2
messages.text: congratulations! That's really exciting! Let's get out a bottle of wine to celebrate!
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 1
messages.text: shouldn't we finish writing this letter first?
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 2
messages.text: ah. That can wait. Your promotion is the best news I've heard in a long time!
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 1
messages.text: it is good news, but it looked like you were almost finished. We might as well just sign off.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 2
messages.text: ok, you're right. I'll just tell them how round I am of you for getting a promotion and then I'll thank Sue for her kind letter.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 1
messages.text: I guess you can write that I'm looking forward to seeing them in June.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 2
messages.text: that's thoughtful of you.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 1
messages.text: and also thank them from the bottom of my heart for the Christmas package they sent us.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 2
messages.text: that's right! I almost forgot about that.
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 1
messages.text: what would you do without me?
messages.label: OTHER

messages.speaker: Person 2
messages.text: we do balance each other out well. I guess we were really made for each other!
messages.label: OTHER
